name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project has completed a Definitive Feasibility Study and holds all key permits, with the company targeting first production in 2029. AbraSilver is transitioning from advanced exploration into development, having recently appointed new leadership aligned with project execution and a construction decision.
